description: This file defines a React component named ProtectedRoute that guards certain routes by checking authentication status and optional admin privileges, involving token decoding and navigation logic.

methods.name: decodeJwtPayload(token)
methods.description: Decodes the payload part of a JWT token, returning the JSON object or null if decoding fails.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children, requireAdmin = false })
methods.description: A React component that renders children if the user is authenticated (and optionally is an admin), otherwise redirects.

ctags.name: ProtectedRoute
ctags.pattern: /^export default function ProtectedRoute({ children, requireAdmin = false }) {$/
